integrity: The finite-state argument establishes all lengths. Brute force for small lengths is an independent cross-check, not a replacement for proof. No external mathematical validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary open two-row Cartesian ladders with at least two columns are classified. Wider or periodically closed grids and weighted counting are not covered. Historical priority remains provisional because the full text of the closest 2026 preprint was unavailable to inspect.
title: Period-three rigidity of perfect edge domination on open ladders
